notes: The payload of each state is what gets JSON.serialize'd into PlanUpgradeCardData.upgradeJSON. The 'default' state is what PlanUpgradeCardDemo returns.

states.label: Upgrade available
states.description: The main case: the customer's current plan next to the recommended faster one, with the monthly difference called out.

payload.reason: Faster upload speeds and priority support, with the install fee waived.

states.label: Already on the top plan
states.description: Nothing to upsell. The card still shows what the customer has and says plainly that it is the fastest plan available, so the rep can close the topic instead of hunting for an offer that doesn't exist. Omitting 'recommended' is what hides the second column, the delta, and both buttons.

payload.note: Fiber 2 Gig is the fastest residential plan available at this address.

states.label: Error
states.description: The sentinel shape. The service returns this instead of null so the card still mounts and can say what went wrong.

payload.error: Could not reach the plan catalog. Try again in a moment.
